goal: Validate the corrected conservative physics against the exact Stage-2 teacher before fan postprocessing.

required_audits.name: native_finite_volume_balance
required_audits.requirement: Instrument or faithfully reproduce the exact Godunov update on the native NX_TRAIN grid and evaluate the discrete conservation balance using the same face fluxes and time step.
required_audits.purpose: Confirm the numerical teacher is conservative before any fan mapping.

required_audits.name: native_grid_continuous_residual_diagnostic
required_audits.requirement: Evaluate a continuous-form diagnostic on raw native-grid snapshots using sufficiently dense source-native time sampling, while clearly separating it from the exact discrete FV balance.
required_audits.purpose: Quantify finite-difference/truncation behavior without fan processing.

required_audits.name: fan_processing_ablation
required_audits.requirement: Apply fan operations sequentially and measure their effect: front extraction -> interpolation to xi -> Sw_star flooring -> forced endpoints -> sparse six-time sampling.
required_audits.purpose: Identify which representation step creates the B2O residual inflation.

required_audits.name: Nc0_control
required_audits.requirement: Use Nc=0 as the mandatory derivation/audit control case.
required_audits.purpose: The corrected conservative formulation must nest the incompressible limit before positive-Nc interpretation is accepted.

required_audits.name: positive_Nc_sweep
required_audits.requirement: Repeat the same audit at physical Nc=0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30.
required_audits.purpose: Separate real compressibility effects from representation artifacts.

front_speed_policy.reason: B2N supports RH physically; B2O shows RH-vs-FD is not the dominant source of processed-fan residual inflation.

acceptance_policy: No new scientific numeric threshold. Use exact discrete-balance identities, convergence/truncation behavior, Nc=0 control, and representation-ablation evidence to decide whether the corrected residual is ready for a training protocol.
